text: Accepting all three voices: (1) never loosen the 5-gram gate globally — only a declared refrain on the blueprint that both validators subtract (story-engine-1); (2) refrains must be joinable, positive or neutral — never prohibition, blame or shaming lines; note that one of my own examples ('No, Amahle, you are too young.') is exactly such a prohibition line and would fail this rule (privacy-safety-1); (3) bedtime is the best first fit, with the changed final refrain carrying the calm landing (content-library prototype).
